compatibilityVersionContract: The pilot emits axm.portable-skill-contract/v1 plus SKILL.md and refuses undeclared authoring fields.
failureAndRecovery: Malformed or over-budget declarations are refused before portable files are assembled; no partial files are retained by the Foundry.
permissionsAndConsent: no inherited authority; the host must separately possess and re-check every capability it uses
promotionGate: Mike reviews the skill procedure, builder source, evidence, catalog diff, and host boundary before any activation or merge.
purpose: Build a portable bounded capability-review procedure that a human or authorized agent host can follow without repeated model invention.
resourceBudget: At most 32 procedure steps, 16 inputs, 16 outputs, 16 boundaries, and 128 KiB per portable file.
sideEffects: none; the skill is portable instruction and contract material only
verificationContract: Prove exact portable files, deterministic bytes, closed input refusal, bounded steps, external selftest behavior, and no authority inheritance.
